local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local VirtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Configuration globale avec WallCheck intégré
getgenv().AimbotSettings = {
    Enabled = false,
    TeamCheck = true,
    WallCheck = true, -- WallCheck activé par défaut
    Smoothness = 1,
    AimSpeed = 15,
    TargetPart = "Head",
    FOV = 200,
    ShowFOV = true,
    Prediction = true,
    PredictionFactor = 0.165,
    SpinBot = false,
    InfiniteJump = false,
    WalkSpeedVal = 16,
    ESPEnabled = false,
    Box3DEnabled = false,
    AutoShoot = false,
    HitboxSize = 2,
    HitboxTransparency = 0.5,
    HitboxEnabled = false,
    HitboxTargetPart = "HumanoidRootPart",
    HitboxVisible = true,
    FriendCheck = true,
    SilentMode = true,
    AutoReset = true,
    ContinuousLock = false,
    AntiCollision = true,
    PrecisionBoost = false
}

-- Tables pour stocker les éléments visuels stables
local Box3DObjects = {}
local HitboxBoxes = {}

local function RemoveBox3D(player)
    if Box3DObjects[player] then
        Box3DObjects[player]:Destroy()
        Box3DObjects[player] = nil
    end
end

local function RemoveHitboxCube(player)
    if HitboxBoxes[player] then
        HitboxBoxes[player]:Destroy()
        HitboxBoxes[player] = nil
    end
end

-- Fonction de WallCheck par Raycast
local function IsVisible(targetPart)
    if not getgenv().AimbotSettings.WallCheck then return true end
    
    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local direction = (targetPart.Position - origin)
    
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local ignoreList = {LocalPlayer.Character}
    if targetPart.Parent then
        table.insert(ignoreList, targetPart.Parent)
    end
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreList
    raycastParams.IgnoreWater = true

    local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, raycastParams)
    return result == nil
end

-- Écran de chargement initial
local function CreateLoadingScreen(duration, onComplete)
    local LoadGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    LoadGui.Name = "LoadingScreenGUI"
    LoadGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    LoadGui.Parent = game.CoreGui

    local LoadFrame = Instance.new("Frame")

    LoadFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -190, 0.5, -90)
    LoadFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25)
    LoadFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    LoadFrame.Parent = LoadGui

    local LoadTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    LoadTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
    LoadTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 15)
    LoadTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    LoadTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    LoadTitle.Text = "..."
    LoadTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 100)
    LoadTitle.TextSize = 22
    LoadTitle.Parent = LoadFrame

    local LoadBarBackground = Instance.new("Frame")
    LoadBarBackground.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 12)
    LoadBarBackground.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -160, 0, 85)
    LoadBarBackground.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 45)
    LoadBarBackground.BorderSizePixel = 0
    LoadBarBackground.Parent = LoadFrame

    local LoadBarFill = Instance.new("Frame")
    LoadBarFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    LoadBarFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 100)
    LoadBarFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    LoadBarFill.Parent = LoadBarBackground

    local LoadStatus = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    LoadStatus.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
    LoadStatus.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 115)
    LoadStatus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    LoadStatus.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    LoadStatus.Text = "0%"
    LoadStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
    LoadStatus.TextSize = 12
    LoadStatus.Parent = LoadFrame

    task.spawn(function()
        local startTime = tick()
        local randomChars = {"#", "$", "@", "!", "?", "%", "&", "*", "a", "i", "m", "b", "o", "t"}
        while tick() - startTime < duration do
            local elapsed = tick() - startTime
            local progress = math.clamp(elapsed / duration, 0, 1)
            LoadBarFill.Size = UDim2.new(progress, 0, 1, 0)
            LoadStatus.Text = math.floor(progress * 100) .."%"
            if progress < 0.75 then
                local scrambled = ""
                for i = 1, 6 do
                    scrambled = scrambled .. randomChars[math.random(1, #randomChars)]
                end
                LoadTitle.Text = scrambled
            else
                LoadTitle.Text = "aimbot"
            end
            task.wait(0.08)
        end
        LoadTitle.Text = "aimbot"
        task.wait(0.5)
        LoadGui:Destroy()
        if onComplete then
            onComplete()
        end
    end)
end

        local KnobCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

        KnobCorner.Parent = Knob

        local dragging = false

        Knob.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
            dragging = true
        end)

        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)

        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation().X
                local barPos = Bar.AbsolutePosition.X
                local barSize = Bar.AbsoluteSize.X

                local value = math.floor(min + (max - min) * percent)
                Label.Text = name .. " : " .. tostring(value)
                callback(value)
            end
        end)

    -- Fonction pour trouver la cible la plus proche avec prise en compte du WallCheck
    local function GetClosestPlayer()
        local closestPlayer = nil
        local shortestDistance = getgenv().AimbotSettings.FOV

        local screenCenter = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
        if UserInputService.MouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
            screenCenter = screenCenter + Vector2.new(15, 0)
        end

        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                if getgenv().AimbotSettings.TeamCheck and LocalPlayer.Team and player.Team and player.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then
                    continue
                end

                if getgenv().AimbotSettings.FriendCheck and LocalPlayer:IsFriendsWith(player.UserId) then
                    continue
                end

                local character = player.Character
                if character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    local targetPart = character:FindFirstChild(getgenv().AimbotSettings.TargetPart)
                    if targetPart then
                        local screenPoint, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(targetPart.Position)
                        if onScreen then
                            local distance = (Vector2.new(screenPoint.X, screenPoint.Y) - screenCenter).Magnitude

                            -- Vérification de la distance (FOV) ET de la visibilité réelle (WallCheck)
                            if distance < shortestDistance and IsVisible(targetPart) then
                                shortestDistance = distance
                                closestPlayer = character
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        return closestPlayer
    end

    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        FOVFrame.Visible = getgenv().AimbotSettings.ShowFOV
        local diameter = getgenv().AimbotSettings.FOV * 2
        FOVFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, diameter, 0, diameter)
        
        local currentScreenCenter = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
        if UserInputService.MouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
            currentScreenCenter = currentScreenCenter + Vector2.new(15, 0)
        end
        FOVFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, currentScreenCenter.X, 0, currentScreenCenter.Y)

        -- Logique Hitbox Expander
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                if getgenv().AimbotSettings.FriendCheck and LocalPlayer:IsFriendsWith(player.UserId) then
                    continue
                end

                local character = player.Character
                if character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    local partName = getgenv().AimbotSettings.HitboxTargetPart
                    local targetPart = character:FindFirstChild(partName)
                    if targetPart then
                        if getgenv().AimbotSettings.HitboxEnabled then
                            local scale = getgenv().AimbotSettings.HitboxSize
                            if getgenv().AimbotSettings.PrecisionBoost then
                                scale = scale * 1.25
                            end
                            targetPart.Size = Vector3.new(scale * 2, scale * 2, scale * 2)
                            targetPart.Transparency = getgenv().AimbotSettings.HitboxVisible and getgenv().AimbotSettings.HitboxTransparency or 1
                            targetPart.CanCollide = not getgenv().AimbotSettings.AntiCollision

                            if getgenv().AimbotSettings.HitboxVisible then
                                if not HitboxBoxes[player] then
                                    local selectionBox = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
                                    selectionBox.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
                                    selectionBox.LineThickness = 0.03
                                    selectionBox.SurfaceTransparency = 0.8
                                    selectionBox.Parent = game.CoreGui
                                    HitboxBoxes[player] = selectionBox
                                end
                                HitboxBoxes[player].Adornee = targetPart
                                HitboxBoxes[player].Visible = true
                            else
                                if HitboxBoxes[player] then
                                    HitboxBoxes[player].Visible = false
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            targetPart.Size = Vector3.new(2, 1, 1)
                            targetPart.Transparency = 1
                            targetPart.CanCollide = true
                            RemoveHitboxCube(player)
                        end
                    else
                        RemoveHitboxCube(player)
                    end
                else
                    RemoveHitboxCube(player)
                end
            else
                RemoveHitboxCube(player)
            end
        end

        -- Logique Cube 3D (Box ESP)
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                if getgenv().AimbotSettings.Box3DEnabled then
                    local character = player.Character
                    if character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                        if not Box3DObjects[player] then
                            local selectionBox = Instance.new("SelectionBox")
                            selectionBox.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
                            selectionBox.LineThickness = 0.04
                            selectionBox.SurfaceTransparency = 0.9
                            selectionBox.Parent = game.CoreGui
                            Box3DObjects[player] = selectionBox
                        end
                        Box3DObjects[player].Adornee = character
                        Box3DObjects[player].Visible = true
                    else
                        RemoveBox3D(player)
                    end
                else
                    RemoveBox3D(player)
                end
            end
        end

        if getgenv().AimbotSettings.SpinBot and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(30), 0)
        end

        -- Logique Aimbot avec Speed Aim & WallCheck
        if getgenv().AimbotSettings.Enabled or getgenv().AimbotSettings.ContinuousLock then
            local target = GetClosestPlayer()
            if target and target:FindFirstChild(getgenv().AimbotSettings.TargetPart) then
                local targetPart = target[getgenv().AimbotSettings.TargetPart]
                local finalPosition = targetPart.Position
                
                if getgenv().AimbotSettings.Prediction and target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    local velocity = target.HumanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                    finalPosition = finalPosition + (velocity * getgenv().AimbotSettings.PredictionFactor)
                end

                local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, finalPosition)
                local speedFactor = math.clamp(getgenv().AimbotSettings.AimSpeed / 25, 0.05, 1)
                Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(targetCFrame, speedFactor)

                if getgenv().AimbotSettings.AutoShoot and widgetActive then
                    pcall(function()
                        VirtualUser:Button1Down(Vector2.new(0,0))
                        task.wait(0.05)
                        VirtualUser:Button1Up(Vector2.new(0,0))
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
